### Fixed
- **"Records owned by deactivated users" was always zero.** The signal could not
  fire: HubSpot hides deactivated users from the owner list unless you ask for
  archived owners, so the audit never had an id to match records against, and
  every report showed nothing to clean up. It now reports what is really there,
  and on real portals that is thousands of records rather than none. Data-quality
  findings that mention stranded records are worth a re-run.
